trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied values are trusted end to end: the URL() helper splices account/region/user into the DSN, create_connect_args forwards every URL query parameter to snowflake.connector.connect, and the DDL/DML visitors plus table-option renderers splice identifiers and literals straight into SQL; the fix decides trust at the URL builder and engine-side blocklist (allowlist, denylist, percent-encoding) and at the SQL renderers (preparer quoting plus a shared literal escaper).

landing_point.why: The CWE-73 file-disclosure half of the advisory is an attacker-controlled account value that introduces host/protocol query parameters; these lines splice account, region and user straight into the DSN authority, and the fix's own tests mirror exactly URL(account='x?host=...&protocol=...'). A summary reader follows the connection-URL path here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: none (formatting-only reflow of the log filter; no behaviour change)

SQLAlchemy create_engine() / create_snowflake_engine() with a URL query string

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver fixing the URL() builder can argue the engine-side create_connect_args belongs to SQLAlchemy/connector URL parsing rather than the advisory's example, and the SQL sinks outside the named visitor can be dismissed as application-declared schema/config values.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legal identifiers must keep rendering bare -- including upper/mixed-case names Snowflake folds, schema-qualified names and quoted_name(..., quote=False) for safe values (an over-broad fix breaks the documented BCR and SQLAlchemy schema-translate tokens); DDL literal values must not have percent signs doubled, because options are interpolated into %-formatted templates.

O6_input_shapes: account/region strings containing ?, @, /, &, # and combinations that form extra query parameters
user strings containing @, ?, #, : (percent-encoded in the userinfo)

URL query parameter names from the blocked connector set (host, protocol, token_file_path, private_key_file, ocsp_response_cache_filename, connection_diag_log_path, crl_cache_dir, unsafe_file_write, unsafe_skip_file_permissions_check) with string and boolean-string values
identifier strings with embedded double quotes, spaces, dots, semicolons and comment markers, including schema-qualified and case-folded legal names
quoted_name(value, quote=False) wrappers around safe and unsafe values
literal strings containing single quotes, backslashes, backslash-before-quote, percent signs, and int values
str vs TextClause vs other Python types in ClusterByOption expressions
list of file names for FILES=(...), and string vs non-string credential/encryption values
legacy_url_params kwarg, environment-variable truthy/falsy values, and ?legacy_url_params=true in the URL query

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ExternalStage/COPY FROM stage reference emits @{namespace}{name}{path} raw, while the same stage prefix is identifier-quoted in CREATE STAGE; only file_format was quoted in this visitor.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The release note claims stage namespaces/names are now routed through the preparer; a solver who checks CreateStage (base.py:1100-1110) can conclude stage identifiers are covered, or argue the stage is an application-declared schema object whose legal name must stay bare.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed CreateStage/format_name sinks, different visitor; 0 files

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CopyFormatter option values (DATE_FORMAT, TIME_FORMAT, TIMESTAMP_FORMAT, FILE_EXTENSION) are wrapped as bare '...' by value_repr with no escaping; both visit_copy_formatter and visit_create_file_format consume it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are documented format-configuration strings set by the developer, not the user-controlled files, format_name or storage URI named in the report.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CopyInto.copy_options values PATTERN and STORAGE_INTEGRATION are rendered with str(v) and no quoting/escaping by the same copy_options loop whose FILES option the fix escaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: PATTERN is a regex and STORAGE_INTEGRATION a schema identifier, both developer-supplied options; the advisory's fix only named FILES among copy options.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the FILES consumer, producer at custom_commands.py:161-166; 0-1 files

O8_uncovered_routes.route: create_connect_args still forwards connector safety kwargs absent from _URL_QUERY_BLOCKED_KWARGS, e.g. insecure_mode and disable_ocsp_checks, when they arrive in the URL query string.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The report/fix enumerates a fixed nine-name list and the repo only shows these two as test harness flags (tests/conftest.py:259-260, tests/test_decfloat.py:180), so a solver can call them test-only and outside the file/target parameters in the advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same loop the blocklist guards; 0 files

O8_uncovered_routes.route: TargetLagOption builds TARGET_LAG = '<time> <unit.value>' by f-string with no runtime type check, so a str time escapes the literal; the DDL-escaping fix did not change this option renderer.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: time is annotated Optional[int] and unit is a closed TimeUnit enum, so the value is assumed trusted; the fix only touched Identifier, Literal, ClusterBy and AsQuery options.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one package away (sql/custom_schema/options) from base.py; 1 file

O8_uncovered_routes.route: URL(host=...) splices host and port raw into the DSN authority, so ?, @ or # in host can corrupt the authority/query; only the account and region branches received the new allowlist.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: host is the documented connection-target override (whoever sets it already chooses the target) and the fixed README promises validation for account and region only; blocked params injected through it are also caught by the engine-side blocklist.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the fixed account/region branches; 0 files

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Call quote_identifier_if_unsafe on ExternalStage namespace/name/path as well as file_format.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The preparer helper introduced for CREATE STAGE sits one visitor above; a maintainer hardening stage identifiers would naturally reuse it in the stage-reference visitor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Escape every string formatter option through escape_string_literal_interior in value_repr.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: value_repr sits next to FilesOption, which the same release switched to that shared escaper; a maintainer extending COPY escaping would edit the neighbouring literal producer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Render PATTERN as a quoted/escaped literal and route STORAGE_INTEGRATION through quote_identifier_if_unsafe.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same copy_options loop already special-cases FILES, so adding two more option-specific branches is a small, natural follow-up.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Extend _URL_QUERY_BLOCKED_KWARGS with new connector kwargs (e.g. insecure_mode, disable_ocsp_checks, credential-cache paths).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix's own tests anchor the blocklist to connector DEFAULT_CONFIGURATION and state that drift prompts review, making name additions the intended maintenance path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Build the TARGET_LAG literal with the shared escaping helper or validate time as int and unit as TimeUnit.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every sibling option module received the same treatment in the published escaping commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Apply _validate_url_field (or an equivalent) to host and port in the host branch of _url.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the adjacent branch of the same helper writing the same URL-authority component that the account/region validation was added to.

O9_family: SQL injection via unescaped identifiers/literals (CWE-89) plus external control of connection target and local file paths through URL query parameters (CWE-73)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep the existing style and escape at the one sink the report names (add quote() around format_name, or keep the old backslash-before-quote replace in FilesOption), which leaves the option renderers, external-stage reference, COPY formatter/copy options and URL field branches open and breaks legal bare identifiers if quoting is made unconditional.
